1. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node of the plurality of network nodes is configured to transmit to a second node of the plurality of network nodes at an access attempt percentage, and wherein each of the plurality of network nodes is configured to provide an indicia of its inter-node interference to one or more other nodes of the plurality of network nodes, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on one of the provided indicia.

2. (Original)

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on a minimum desired throughput for each particular node of the plurality of network nodes, and wherein the first node adjusts the access attempt percentage based on the minimum desired throughput of the first node relative to the minimum desired throughput of one or more other nodes.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on a ratio of an indicia of inter-node interference of the first node divided by an indicia of inter-node interference of one or more of the nodes interfered with by transmissions from the first node.

5. (Original)

13. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a first node adapted to communicate wirelessly with a first access point, the first node configured to calculate an access attempt percentage for communications with the first access point, wherein the calculation is based at least partially on a received indicia of inter-node interference between the first node and a second node, and wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on transmission success rate information received from the second node.

14. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast a dynamic weight associated with the second node to the first node, wherein the dynamic weight is based on a transmission success rate of the second node with the first access point.

15. (Original)

16. (Original)

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and the first node interferes with communication between the second node and the second access point, and wherein the first node receives indicia of inter-node interference from the second node that is based on the transmission success rate between the second node and the second access point.

18. (Original)

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to communicate with the first access point using IEEE 802.11a, 802.11b, 802.11g, or 802.11n protocol.

20. (Original)
